input.summary: Add a right to transfer the licence to a successor by merger or acquisition without Garman's approval, and conform the Section 3(c) transfer prohibition.
input.comment: [Playbook] Affiliate use is already covered, but the licence is expressly non-transferable and Section 3(c) bars any transfer without Garman's written authorization, so the licence would not survive a merger or sale of our business. We have added a successor transfer right by merger or acquisition without Garman's approval and conformed Section 3(c), which is our fallback position.

ops.oldText: a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
ops.newText: a non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation. Sparkling may transfer this licence to a successor by merger or acquisition without Garman's approval.

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing
ops.newText: except as permitted by Section 2 or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing
